text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines do tasks that people used to do, especially repetitive jobs. At the same time, productivity tools help workers finish tasks faster and with fewer mistakes. Many companies now encourage human-AI collaboration, where people and AI work together. For example, AI can suggest ideas, and humans make the final decisions. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI is not just a tool; it is transforming how we work.
